ai-facebook-messenger-assistant.challenge: Online businesses get flooded with the same repetitive questions — product details, shipping, ordering, store policies. Owners either burn hours replying manually or leave customers waiting, losing sales in the process.
features: Google Docs as the live knowledge base
GET / POST branching with an If node
Filter node to keep only valid message events
HTTP Request node posting to the Messenger API
Zero-code content updates — just edit the doc
outcomes: Business Value
24/7 instant customer support
Consistent, on-brand answers every time
Owners freed from repetitive DM replies
Faster response times = more converted buyers
Knowledge base updated by editing a Google Doc — no workflow changes
ai-facebook-messenger-assistant.solution: Built an AI-powered Facebook Messenger Assistant in n8n. Incoming messages hit a webhook, the AI agent pulls context from a Google Docs knowledge base (products, FAQs, ordering, shipping, policies), generates a contextual response with an LLM, and posts it straight back through the Facebook Messenger API — instantly, around the clock.
workflow: Customer sends a message on Facebook Messenger
n8n receives the message via Webhook
AI Agent fetches the Google Docs knowledge base
LLM generates a contextual response from the retrieved info
HTTP Request sends the reply back through the Facebook Messenger API
Customer receives an instant, on-brand answer

zapier-asana-crm-automation.challenge: The business ran its entire sales pipeline manually — creating client folders, chasing unresponsive leads, following up on quotes, sending onboarding docs, and remembering to re-engage past customers. Admin work was eating the team's day and leads were slipping through the cracks.
features: Automatic Google Drive folder creation per client
outcomes: Business Value
Repetitive admin work eliminated
No lead or quote left un-followed
Every new client onboarded consistently
Long-term customer relationships nurtured on autopilot
zapier-asana-crm-automation.solution: Built a 28-step Zapier automation triggered from Asana task stages. Each stage — Ready to Start, No Response, Quoted, Approved, Paid and Closed — routes down its own path: creating Google Drive folders, sending scheduled follow-ups, delivering onboarding docs, and firing personalised service recommendations after the project closes.
workflow: Asana task updated → Zapier trigger fires
Zapier splits into paths based on the task's stage
Ready to Start: create Google Drive folder + Asana subtasks
No Response / Quoted: send scheduled Gmail follow-ups until the client replies
Approved: attach onboarding PDF from Drive and send welcome email
Paid and Closed: send personalised service recommendation emails based on the purchased service

make-xero-asana-accounting-automation.challenge: Finance and ops teams were manually exporting Xero account transactions and attaching them to completed Asana project tasks. It was repetitive, error-prone, and forced constant switching between platforms just to close out a project cleanly.
features: Google Sheets staging for row iteration
CSV formatted to match Xero's native export
outcomes: Business Value
Manual Xero exports eliminated
Financial reports live on the project task itself
No more platform-switching to close out projects
Consistent, audit-ready accounting attachments
make-xero-asana-accounting-automation.solution: Built a Make.com scenario that triggers when an Asana task is marked complete, authenticates with Xero, pulls the previous calendar year's transaction-level data, formats it into a CSV that mirrors Xero's native Account Transactions report, and uploads it straight back to the Asana task as an attachment.
workflow: Make.com watches Asana for completed tasks
Xero API call retrieves account transactions for the previous calendar year
Router splits the flow: iterate rows and stage them in Google Sheets
Text aggregator formats the rows into a CSV matching Xero's report layout
Asana module uploads the CSV as an attachment on the completed task
Google Sheets range is cleared, ready for the next run

ghl-lead-intake-automation.challenge: The business was drowning in raw form submissions with no way to tell hot buyers from tire-kickers. Sales reps wasted hours triaging, hot leads went cold, and follow-up was inconsistent — costing real revenue every week.
features: BANT scoring via Math Operation accumulation
Instant internal SMS alert on hot leads
outcomes: Business Value
Hot leads reached while intent is still hot
Zero manual triage for the sales team
Consistent follow-up on every single lead
Clean, tagged CRM data for reporting and segmentation
ghl-lead-intake-automation.solution: Built a GoHighLevel workflow that fires within 90 seconds of form submission. Math Operation accumulation scores each lead 0–100 across budget, timeline, decision-maker status, and service type. Hot leads (70+) trigger an instant internal SMS to the sales rep; warm leads enter a nurture sequence; cold leads drip slowly. Every contact is auto-tagged, pipelined, and assigned a task — no manual input.
workflow: Prospect submits the contact form
Workflow fires within 90 seconds
BANT scoring accumulates 0–100 via Math Operations
Dedup check for returning leads
Conditional tagging across 4 BANT factors (61 tags / 10 categories)
Phone validation → hot leads (70+) SMS the rep instantly
Warm leads → nurture sequence · Cold leads → slow drip
Contact added to pipeline stage and task auto-assigned

ghl-14-day-nurture-sequence.challenge: New roofing leads went cold within days. There was no consistent follow-up, no way to detect when a lead had already replied or booked, and no system for re-engaging leads who never took action — meaning marketing spend was leaking every week.
features: Full email + SMS copy written for every message
Reply detection pauses sequence + alerts rep
Behavioral scoring for opens, clicks and replies
outcomes: Business Value
No lead left cold in the pipeline
Automated messages stop the moment a lead converts
Sales notified instantly on every reply
More booked appointments from the same lead volume
ghl-14-day-nurture-sequence.solution: Designed and built a complete 7-message, 14-day nurture sequence in GoHighLevel covering every stage of the buyer journey: Day 1 education, Day 3 case study social proof, Day 5 personal check-in SMS, Day 7 objection handling, Day 10 soft offer, and Day 14 honest urgency close. Three goal events exit the lead the instant they convert, reply detection pauses and alerts sales, and behavioral scoring lets engagement move leads from cold to hot.
workflow: Lead enters the 14-day sequence
Day 1 — educational email
Day 3 — case study social proof
Day 5 — personal check-in SMS
Day 7 — objection-handling email
Day 10 — soft offer
Day 14 — honest urgency close
Goal events exit on appointment booked, deal closed, or SMS reply

ghl-appointment-booking-automation.challenge: Prospects were booking calls and never showing up, and even more were abandoning the booking page mid-flow. Without automated confirmations, reminders, and recovery, the business was leaking revenue on both sides of the calendar.
features: No-show detection 30 min after start time
Urgent internal tasks for the sales rep
outcomes: Business Value
20–30% of abandoned bookings recovered
No-shows re-engaged automatically
Every appointment reminded across SMS and email
Sales team alerted the moment intent signals fire
ghl-appointment-booking-automation.solution: Built a complete appointment automation system in GoHighLevel combining two workflows. Booking Confirmation fires instantly on booking — personalised SMS + email, day-before reminder, morning-of message, and 2-hour heads-up, with no-show detection 30 minutes after start time that auto-sends a rebooking SMS and creates an urgent sales task. Abandoned Booking Recovery watches calendar page visits, and when no appointment is created within 30 minutes, fires a recovery SMS + email, bumps lead score +20, and creates an urgent call task.
workflow: Prospect books → instant personalised SMS + confirmation email
Day-before reminder · morning-of message · 2-hour heads-up
30 min after start time → no-show detection fires rebooking SMS + urgent task
Separate flow: calendar page visit tracked as intent
30-min check — if no confirmed appointment, mark as abandoned
Recovery SMS + email sent, lead score +20, urgent call task assigned
